prompt: Write a COBOL program that displays the numbers 1 to 10.
completion:

```cobol
       PROGRAM-ID. COUNT10.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-I PIC 9(2).

               DISPLAY WS-I
           END-PERFORM.
           STOP RUN.
```

prompt: Write a COBOL program that computes 5 factorial and displays it.
completion:
```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FACT5.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-N    PIC 9(2) VALUE 5.
       01 WS-FACT PIC 9(6) VALUE 1.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-N = 0
               MULTIPLY WS-N BY WS-FACT
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-N
           END-PERFORM.
           DISPLAY WS-FACT.
           STOP RUN.
```

prompt: Write a COBOL program that checks whether 14 is even or odd and displays EVEN or ODD.
completion:
```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. EVENODD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-N   PIC 9(3) VALUE 14.
       01 WS-Q   PIC 9(3).
       01 WS-R   PIC 9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DIVIDE WS-N BY 2 GIVING WS-Q REMAINDER WS-R.
           IF WS-R = 0
               DISPLAY "EVEN"
           ELSE
               DISPLAY "ODD"
           END-IF.
           STOP RUN.
```

prompt: Write a COBOL program that sums the numbers 1 to 100 and displays the result.
completion:
```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SUM100.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-I   PIC 9(3).
       01 WS-SUM PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 100
               ADD WS-I TO WS-SUM
           END-PERFORM.
           DISPLAY WS-SUM.
           STOP RUN.
```
